title: Inversion and emphasis
grammar: Inversion (Not only, Never have I), Cleft sentences

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn inversion and cleft sentences to give emphasis to what you say.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. Never have I seen such a beautiful place. Not only did she arrive late, but she also forgot the tickets. It was John who called. Notice the inversion after negative adverbs.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: After Never at the start, we invert subject and auxiliary.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences starting with Never, Rarely or Not only to add emphasis.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: It ___ my sister who told me the news.
phases.explanation: Cleft sentence: It + be + noun + who/that + verb.
